issues.description: Default and tiny extraction point at data/stories, but the repository contains no story manifest or story files.
Story loading hard-fails on missing files with no generator, fixture, or documented bootstrap path, making the demo unreproducible.
The checked-in end-to-end test currently fails at extraction because required corpus data is absent.
Validation loads saved vectors but instantiates the backend from CLI config without checking manifest backend, model, layer count, or d_model compatibility.
Preference steering also ignores vector manifest compatibility, so vectors can be scored with the wrong backend or model.
HF preference_logit scores one activity via good-minus-bad next-token logits rather than a true pairwise preference comparison.
Elo rankings are derived from independent scalar logits, contradicting the README's claim of pairwise preference logits.
The dosage probe changes only numeric tokens, but the tiny backend ignores numeric magnitude, producing a non-informative constant activation curve.
Checked-in dosage results are identical for all doses, showing the validation artifact does not support the claimed modulation probe.
Checked-in artifacts reference a source story manifest and topics that are not present in the repository, so artifacts are stale or unreproducible.
HuggingFace tokenizer/model downloads are not pinned to a revision, making full-backend results non-reproducible and supply-chain-sensitive.
Dependencies use broad lower bounds with no lockfile or hash pinning, so test and production behavior can drift over time.
Activity-token localization falls back to steering every prompt token when offsets are unavailable, which changes the intended intervention.
pca_components_for_variance returns one component for threshold 0 instead of zero components.
steering.min_reported_emotions is configured but unused because steer_prefs hardcodes four reported emotions.
Integration assertions mostly check file existence and one boolean, missing regressions like constant dosage output or manifest/backend mismatches.
